quests.title: Wake in the Wire
quests.summary: You woke in Static Row with no memory and one ability: to walk between the real city and the Grid. Find out why the Signal went quiet.

objectives.text: Talk to the Fixer in Static Row
Cross the wall in the Grid and hack the first terminal
Open the east gate (relay and south terminals)

reward.text: The Fixer's parting gift: Phase Boots.

quests.title: The Archive
quests.summary: Every memory the Curator deleted ends up in the Archive. Reach its core and decide what the city remembers.

objectives.text: Hack the terminal at the end of the shelf hall

quests.title: Lost Memories
quests.summary: Fragments of your past are scattered through the Grid. Each one is a piece of who you were.

quests.title: Clear the Streets
quests.summary: Trace drones and enforcers are hunting everyone who still remembers. Thin them out.

quests.title: Whispers in the Plaza
quests.summary: Some walls in Vantage Plaza only exist in the real world. Something may be hidden behind them.

objectives.text: Find the hidden cache in Vantage Plaza

quests.title: Open Nodes
quests.summary: Old data nodes still hum in every district. Crack them all to rebuild a clean Signal cell.

reward.text: A clean power source: Signal Cell.
